notes.title: Updated to v.1.0.7
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the answer to the in-game riddle was not recognized as correct when in CAPS LOCK.

notes.title: Updated to v.1.0.5
notes.content:
Migrated Unity to latest stable release. 

Fixed couple of issues that emerged during the migration process.

Fixed a bug where you were unable to click on your hero while your hero is rotated to its default's opposite direction. 

[i]If you encounter any bugs, please, post in the community hub and I'll see to it right away. Thank you all for your support![/i]

notes.title: Updated to v.1.0.4
notes.content:
Fixed a bug when instead of one achievement you got another.

Fixed a couple of typos.

[i]As always, anyone who notices any unusual behavior, please let me know and I'll fix it asap. Thank you all for your support![/i]
